如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “这是你去北非的酬劳。”
林老头从一块包裹的很好的破布中，小心翼翼的拿出了两张皱皱巴巴的百元大钞递给了一旁眼巴巴的看着他的林逸。
林逸不明白，自己执行的任务是那么的危险，自己的敌人是那么的强大，委托人获得的利益是那么的丰厚，到头来自己的所得却是那么的少。
老头子是从哪儿给自己接的这些极品任务啊？
每次都是九死一生，拿到手的酬劳却是五十、一百，这还好，还有三块两块的时候……
每每想起这些，林逸都想哭。
接过自己用生命换来的二百块钱，林逸最想骂的就是，妈了个蛋的！
虽然他是个孤儿，从小就没有妈。
跟着把自己养大的林老头学了十五年的功夫，读了十五年的书，怎么也算是个文武全才了吧？
放古代那也是文武双全的双榜状元了，却被当做力工一样的使唤……这日子什么时候是个头儿啊！
听说城里面给人盖房子一年还能拿好几万呢，自己每天死去活来的，一年也不过千八百块……
“老头子，你不会是耍我吧？二百块？我很怀疑你是不是在克扣我的酬劳？”
林逸不止一次的怀疑过这件事儿了，可是老头子和他穿的一样吃的一样，又不像有钱人的样子。
“有钱拿就不错了，你以为现在的钱是这么好赚的？”
林老头翻了翻他的鼓泡眼儿，没好气的说道：“怎么？不想要？不想要就还给我，我好久没去村头王寡妇家的小吃部打牙祭了。”
“……”
林逸很想狂揍眼前这个瘦干瘪老头一顿，但是他知道，自己动手的结果就是被揍。
林老头的功夫到底有多厉害，林逸自己也不知道。
只知道他每次陪自己练功时，都没有使出全力。
就在自己的功夫提升了一个档次时，却突然发现，老头子也提升了一个档次，自己依然是他的手下败将。

“好了，这些年你也历练的差不多了，那一件大事，也差不多是时候了。”
林老头眼皮都不抬一下，盘腿坐在炕上，吧唧吧唧的磕着面前的一碟茴香豆：“这个任务你做好了，一辈子就不愁吃喝了！”
“真的假的？”
林逸知道自己从三岁被老头子捡破烂时捡回来开始，就跟着老头子学功夫，学医术，学外面的知识，就是为了去做一件大事！
可是林逸却很怀疑这个大事的酬劳究竟有没有老头子说的那么多，一个任务可以吃一辈子。
“我什么时候骗过你？”
林老头又扔进口中一枚茴香豆：“你去不去？不去我换人了？”
“去，我当然去！”
林逸心道，这么好的事儿，傻子才不去呢！
一个任务可以吃一辈子，自己以后可就不用这么死去活来了。
就算是龙潭虎穴，拼了也值了！
“恩，那你去吧，你去松山市，鹏展集团，找一个叫楚鹏展的人，他会告诉你接下来要做什么。”
林老头的嘴角划过一丝不易察觉的奸笑：“不过你可要想好了，一旦接下了这个任务，就一定要做下去，中途可不能退出。”
“为什么？有危险还不让人跑路啊？”
林逸可不是那种一根筋的人，明知道会死亡的事情可是坚决不做。
“小逸啊，老子养你了十五年，供你吃，供你喝，给你买笔记本电脑，给你买3G网卡……”
老头子眼睛一翻，喋喋不休的唠叨了起来：“让你做点儿事你就这么多问题，你别逼我！”
“靠！”
林逸听了老头子的话就气不打一处来：“前三年你养我，六岁开始就是我做饭，我劈柴，我编草鞋赚钱养你，你也别逼我！”
“你半夜偷摸用电脑看什么，别以为我不知道！”

老头子一瞪眼，说道：“这是你逼我说的！你还对着电脑……”
“好吧……我去……我不跑路，行了吧？”
林逸老脸一红，没想到自己做的这么隐秘的事情都被这老家伙察觉了，真他娘的丢脸。
再让他说下去，指不定会说出什么少儿不宜的画面来。
于是，在林老头的威逼加利诱之下，林逸背上了行囊，踏上了北上的火车，不远万里的赶到了松山市，这座现代国际化的大都市。
坐在火车上，林逸对于这一次的任务还是很期待的，这种一个任务就能退休的好事儿，他可是做梦都想要的。
虽说从林老头的话中可以感觉到，这个任务似乎不简单。
恩，不简单才有挑战性嘛！

Old man Lin carefully took out two crumpled hundred-yuan bills from a piece of well-wrapped rag and handed them to Lin Yi, who was looking at him eagerly.
Lin Yi didn't understand that the mission he performed was so dangerous, his enemies were so powerful, and the benefits obtained by his clients were so generous, but in the end his gains were so little.
Where did the old man get these top-notch tasks for himself?
Every time I narrowly escaped death, the reward I got was fifty or one hundred, which was okay, there were still three or two yuan left...
Lin Yi wanted to cry every time he thought of this.
After receiving the two hundred yuan that he had exchanged for his life, what Lin Yi wanted to scold most was, what the fuck!
Although he is an orphan, he has not had a mother since he was a child.
After fifteen years of learning kung fu and fifteen years of reading from the old man Lin who raised him, he can be regarded as a versatile scholar, right?
In ancient times, he was the top pick in both civil and military rankings, but he was treated like a laborer... When did this day end!
I heard that people in the city can get tens of thousands a year for building houses, but I only have to work hard every day for only 1,800 yuan a year...
"Old man, are you kidding me? Two hundred yuan? I doubt you are deducting my remuneration?"
Lin Yi had doubted this more than once, but the old man dressed and ate the same as him, and he didn't look like a rich man.
"It's good to have money. Do you think money is so easy to earn now?"
Old man Lin rolled his bulging eyes and said angrily: "What? You don't want it? If you don't want it, just give it back to me. I haven't gone to the snack bar of the Cuntou Wang Widow's house for a long time to get a toothpaste."
"..."
Lin Yi wanted to beat up the skinny old man in front of him, but he knew that if he did it, he would be beaten.
Lin Yi himself doesn't know how powerful Old Man Lin's kung fu is.
All I know is that every time he practices with me, he doesn't use his full strength.
Just when his kung fu improved to a higher level, he suddenly discovered that the old man had also improved to a higher level, and he was still his defeat.
"Okay, you've had enough experience over the years, and it's almost time for that big event."
Old Man Lin didn't even raise his eyelids, sitting cross-legged on the kang, knocking on a plate of fennel beans in front of him: "If you do this task well, you won't have to worry about food and drink for the rest of your life!"
"Really or not?"
Lin Yi knew that since he was picked up by an old man when he was three years old, he has been learning kung fu, medical skills, and outside knowledge from the old man, just to do something big!
But Lin Yi doubted whether the reward for this important matter was as much as the old man said. One task could last a lifetime.
"When have I ever lied to you?"
Old man Lin threw another fennel bean into his mouth: "Are you going? If not, I will replace you?"
"Go, of course I will go!"
Lin Yi thought to himself, no fool would not go for such a good thing!
A task can last a lifetime, and I won't have to work so hard in the future.
Even if it's a dragon's pond and a tiger's den, it's worth the effort!
"Well, then go ahead. Go to Songshan City, Pengzhan Group, and find a man named Chu Pengzhan. He will tell you what to do next."
An imperceptible evil smile flashed across the corner of Old Man Lin's lips: "But you have to think about it carefully. Once you accept this task, you must continue with it and you cannot quit midway."
"Why? Why don't you let people run away when there is danger?"
Lin Yi is not the kind of person who is single-minded. He will not do anything even though he knows that he will die.
"Xiaoyi, I have raised you for fifteen years, provided you with food, provided you with drink, bought you a laptop, and bought you a 3G network card..."
The old man rolled his eyes and started chattering non-stop: "You only have so many problems when I ask you to do something, don't force me! "
"Depend on! "
Lin Yi became very angry after hearing what the old man said: "You raised me for the first three years. Since I was six years old, I have been cooking, chopping firewood, and weaving straw sandals to earn money to support you. Don't force me! "
"Don't think I don't know what you're secretly reading on your computer in the middle of the night! "
The old man glared and said, "You forced me to say this! You are still facing the computer..."
"Okay... I'll go... I won't run away, okay? "
Lin Yi blushed. He didn't expect that such a secret thing he did would be noticed by this old guy. It's so fucking embarrassing.
If he were to continue talking, he might reveal some scenes that were not suitable for children.
So, under Old Man Lin's coercion and inducement, Lin Yi packed his bags, boarded the train heading north, and traveled thousands of miles to Songshan City, a modern and international metropolis.
Sitting on the train, Lin Yi was still looking forward to this mission. He could only dream of being able to retire with just one mission.
Although it can be felt from Old Man Lin's words that this task does not seem simple.
Well, it’s not easy to be challenging!
